# Workforce360 — Canonical AI & LLM Specification
> AI-Native Workforce Operating System powered by Spotsign and DIMENSHION.

## Canonical Identity
- **Product Name:** Workforce360
- **Category:** AI-Native Workforce Operating System (WOS)
- **Supporting Categories:** Enterprise HRMS, HRIS, Workforce Management (WFM), Statutory Payroll, Talent Acquisition (ATS), Learning Management (LMS), IT Asset Governance, Workforce Finance & General Ledger
- **Brand Line:** Workforce360 — Run your entire workforce on one intelligent platform.
- **Corporate Entity:** Powered by Spotsign • A DIMENSHION Product
- **Website:** https://workforce360.dimension.com (Canonical Root)

## Core Value Proposition
Workforce360 unifies the entire workforce lifecycle across People, Work, Money, IT Operations, and AI Intelligence on one multi-tenant platform. Designed for both corporate white-collar teams and operational, shift-based, blue-collar, and field workforces.

## Five Platform Pillars
1. **People:** Core HR/HRIS, Employee Lifecycle, AI Recruitment (ATS), Performance Management (OKRs & 9-Box), Learning Management (LMS), Employee Experience & Helpdesk.
2. **Work:** Workforce Management, Biometric Attendance Hardware Integration (eSSL, ZKTeco), Shift Rostering (24/7 & Split Shifts), Geofenced Field Tracking.
3. **Money:** Enterprise Payroll Engine, Indian Statutory Compliance (TDS, EPF, ESIC, State PT, Form 12BB, Form 16), Expense Claims, Workforce Finance & General Ledger (GL).
4. **Operations & IT:** IT Asset Tracking, Software License Governance, Offboarding Asset Recovery Lock, Open REST APIs & Webhooks.
5. **Intelligence:** Embedded AI Digital Brain (40 production Genkit AI flows), Workforce Digital Twin Scenario Simulator, Predictive People Analytics.

## Key Strategic Differentiators
- **Workforce Digital Twin:** Isolated organizational simulation sandbox that models restructuring, downsizing, or expansion scenarios and computes real-time P&L delta, severance liability, and critical skill deficits before changes are committed.
- **Embedded AI (40 Genkit Flows):** Contextual AI embedded into workflows (attrition prediction, pre-payroll anomaly audits, AI resume screening, job description synthesis, interview rubrics, and natural language reporting).
- **Dual Workforce Architecture:** Native support for both corporate salaried professionals and variable-wage industrial workers (daily rates, piece-rate gang cards by yield/kg, shift differentials, muster roll Form 25).
- **Indian Statutory & Global Payroll Depth:** Automated calculation of TDS under Old/New regimes, one-click ECR challans for EPFO, ESIC contribution files, state-wise PT slabs, and bulk Form 16 generation.
- **19 Pre-built Industry Vertical Packs:** Tailored configurations for Shipping & Maritime, Seafood Processing, Logistics & Freight, Manufacturing, Chemical & Hazardous Operations, Healthcare, Hospitality, Fisheries & Aquaculture, Cargo Forwarding, Retail & E-Commerce, Fuel Stations, Cab Aggregators, Field Workforce, Automobile Services, Travel & Tourism, School & University, ITES, BPO Call Centers, and Information Technology.

## Multi-Tenant Security & Governance
- Tenant-scoped logical data isolation with sovereign database partitions.
- 19 granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) tiers.
- Enterprise SSO via Firebase supporting Google Workspace and Microsoft Azure AD / Entra ID.
- Immutable audit logging on all administrative modifications.
- Zero customer data used for training public external AI models.
